disposition: Scientifically acceptable to execute the predeclared diagnostic factorial; parameterization acceptance remains pending.
findings_resolved: All passing controls required for every candidate combination.
First-, second-, and third-order paired continuous finite differences declared and implemented at every background.
Five individual strata, original outcome groups, and all case intersections retained.
Strict particle flags and reviewed physical acceptance remain separate from historical within and physical_pass fields.
Effective transitive helpers, owned readers, installed native reader bytes and resolved climate calendar are pinned.
scope_limits: The 116-case panel was selected for diagnosis; it does not estimate full-matrix success or general population effects.
Road pore and conductivity changes are coupled and cannot be separately attributed.
Uniform 200 mm treatment, paved transfer, fixed normalized retention shape and legacy buffer avke-to-horizon Ksat transfer remain hypotheses.
OFE net boundary exchange is not tagged sediment-source attribution.
Every candidate requires all 20 controls, closure of new unexplained accounting flags, and fresh broad validation before holdouts or production consideration.
No UI implementation or parameter/default changes are approved by this design review.
